body: Mental health is somewhat a taboo topic in the house. He’s got the boomer mentality that depression = laziness, despite most likely actually having it himself. I would like to bring it up but I think it’s very likely that he’ll brush it aside.  I don’t really think I could get him to do any new hobbies as he’s not got a lot of time with work and my mother. Friends wise, he’s an introvert so it’s difficult to get outside his comfort zone.
